entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Skowronek (calf) will not play against the Buccaneers this Sunday, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Samuel strained his right hamstring "pretty good" during Sunday's 32-29 win over Seattle and is "going to miss at least a couple weeks," David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Wilson (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: Hudson's agent revealed Tuesday that the tight end sustained a torn pectoral in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Dolphins and is expected to miss the rest of the season, Charlie Clifford of WLWT News 5 Cincinnati reports.

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: Head coach Dan Campbell confirmed Monday that Kennedy will undergo season-ending surgery to repair an MCL injury in his right knee, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Charbonnet (knee) was estimated as a limited practice participant Tuesday, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that Mitchell (finger) underwent a small procedure on his hand and remains week-to-week, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Mayfield (thumb) wasn't spotted on the field for Wednesday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Montgomery (groin) is considered week-to-week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: Head coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that Harris is "week-to-week" due to a hamstring injury that he sustained during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson is expected to miss multiple weeks after he was diagnosed with a right high-ankle sprain following an MRI on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot) was diagnosed with a partial tear of his plantar fascia after exiting Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London and could be sidelined multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that Williams (hamstring) will listed as a full practice participant on Wednesday's estimated injury report, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

entries.name: Carsen Ryan
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: CeeDee Lamb
entries.summary: Lamb is believed to be dealing with a "quad bruise" that is "not considered to be serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Colbie Young
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Darius Slayton
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: David Martin-Robinson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: The Seahawks listed Lock (forearm) as a limited practice participant on Tuesday's estimated report, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker (quadriceps) was spotted participating in the Panthers' unofficial practice session Tuesday, Alex Zietlow of The Charlotte Observer reports.

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
entries.summary: Smith-Njigba (ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Tuesday's estimated practice report, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Joshua Palmer
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion is progressing well in his recovery from a concussion and is set to practice Wednesday, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

entries.name: Kenyon Sadiq
entries.summary: Sadiq won't return to Sunday's game versus the Browns due to a concussion.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (foot) was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) "has a realistic chance" to return to action Sunday against the Browns, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said that Penix (ribs) will practice Wednesday but will be limited in some fashion, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Quentin Johnston
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Quinshon Judkins
entries.summary: Judkins was spotted Wednesday moving around the Cleveland locker room without a boot on his injured right ankle, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers ruled out Moore (ankle) for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Bears.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: The Vikings downgraded Hockenson to out for Sunday's game against the Saints due to a concussion.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Brown (ankle) has "a chance" to return to practice this week, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: The Giants placed Berrios (foot) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: The Packers placed Brooks (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Kirk (calf) is "unlikely" to return to practice this week, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: David Sills
entries.summary: Sills (hamstring) had his 21-day practice window opened by the Buccaneers on Monday, Scott Smith & Brianna Dix of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Paul Gutierrez of Raiders.com reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: The Ravens placed Smythe (Achilles) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: The Browns designated Sampson (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Long (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Lane (wrist) "is expected to return to practice" and per head coach Jesse Minter "has a shot" to play Sunday against the Browns, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Conner (foot) is "getting close" to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Tyson (hamstring) is "progressing well" but isn't on track to return to practice this week, Jeff Nowak of WWL New Orleans reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
entries.summary: The Chargers designated Lambert-Smith (hamstring) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: The Steelers placed Pittman (foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Raheim Sanders
entries.summary: The Browns placed Sanders (hip) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is expected to be ready to return after his four-game stint on injured reserve, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: The Panthers announced Tuesday that Etienne (ankle) is designated to return from injured reserve.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Lance (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
